notes: NEB 5-alpha LacIq with plasmid-borne antibiotic resistance genes (NDM-1, CAT-I, aadB; wild-type allele or single-codon variants), IPTG-induced, no antibiotics. Submitters' controls: uninduced WT allele (heterologous gene present but not induced; genotype_class heterologous_expression, inducer false) and the induced deletion construct ('Delta Gene', treated as empty-vector reference). Base medium unnamed ('media containing ... 2% w/v glucose'), so medium labels left out. 'exponential growth phase' stated in the design.

culture_mode.q: incubated at 37°C with shaking until 330 minutes had passed since first inducing the cultures

growth_phase.q: to ensure the cells were still in exponential growth phase based on OD measurements

genotype_class.q: cells expressing single-codon substitutions in the antibiotic resistance genes NDM-1, CAT-I, or aadB

global_regulator_perturbed.q: cells expressing single-codon substitutions in the antibiotic resistance genes NDM-1, CAT-I, or aadB

inducer_added.q: At time zero, IPTG was added to a concentration of 1 mM

transcription_arrested.q: compare the gene expression profiles of cells expressing single-codon substitutions in the antibiotic resistance genes NDM-1, CAT-I, or aadB in the absence of antibiotics

mixed_organism.q: compare the gene expression profiles of cells expressing single-codon substitutions in the antibiotic resistance genes NDM-1, CAT-I, or aadB in the absence of antibiotics

assay_class.q: mRNA enrichment was completed using the MICROBExpress Bacterial mRNA Enrichment Kit

is_control.q: Controls consisted of cells with the wildtype allele that were not induced with IPTG as well as cells harboring a Δ antibiotic resistance gene deletion that were induced with IPTG
